# cycle-004 windows-correctness — F1 affected-files list
# Format: <change-type>\t<path>\t<note>
# change-type: NEW | MODIFIED | DEPENDENT | DOCS
# Generated by architect (Phase F1 Delta Analysis), 2026-09-03. Analysis only — no src/ changes made.

NEW	src/api/auth_dpapi_store.rs	Candidate path for the new Windows DPAPI-encrypted-file secret store module (final module layout decided at F2/F4; may instead land as a submodule of src/api/auth.rs).
MODIFIED	src/api/auth.rs	store_oauth_tokens, load_oauth_tokens, clear_profile_oauth_pair, clear_profile_creds, clear_all_credentials, and the four "Unlock your keychain" error-message sites (oauth_login store failure ~1138-1151; refresh_oauth_token_with_url load-failure branch ~1229-1239; refresh_oauth_token_with_url store failure ~1328-1341; resolve_refresh_app_credentials keychain-read failure ~1364-1371 — audit only, likely unchanged).
MODIFIED	Cargo.toml	Possible new dependency (windows crate) or continued use of the already-present windows-sys via keyring's windows-native feature — decision at F2/F6 (see delta-analysis.md §6).
MODIFIED	Cargo.lock	Follows whichever Cargo.toml dependency decision is made.
MODIFIED	deny.toml	Possible new [[bans.skip]] entries if a new windows/windows-core/windows-targets version enters the graph.
MODIFIED	README.md	#760: Windows install steps + Unblock-File note, per-platform config/cache path table, cloud_id auto-discovery caveat (OAuth-only).
DEPENDENT	src/api/refresh_coordinator.rs	refresh_with_single_flight wraps a closure that bottoms out in the modified store_oauth_tokens path; no code change expected, test coverage in regression-risk zone.
DEPENDENT	src/api/client.rs	load_oauth_tokens read call sites (from_config auth header; 401 auto-refresh reconcile path) — must transparently see DPAPI-file-backed tokens.
DEPENDENT	src/cli/auth/login.rs	oauth_login caller; relies on the fixed error message propagating unchanged from src/api/auth.rs.
DEPENDENT	src/cli/auth/refresh.rs	refresh_credentials (relogin-then-replace, DEC-321) depends on the new atomic dual-write invariant preserving its "obtain-first, then unconditional overwrite" contract.
DEPENDENT	src/cli/auth/logout.rs	handle_logout calls clear_profile_oauth_pair; depends on it also cleaning up the DPAPI file.
DEPENDENT	src/cli/auth/remove.rs	handle_remove calls clear_profile_creds; same DPAPI-file cleanup dependency.
DEPENDENT	src/cli/auth/status.rs	status() presence-checks via load_oauth_tokens(...).is_ok(); must report "authenticated" correctly for DPAPI-backed tokens.
DEPENDENT	src/config.rs	cache_root()/global_config_dir() path-resolution functions are REUSED (not modified) by the new DPAPI store's location choice (%LOCALAPPDATA%\jr).
DEPENDENT	src/cache.rs	Same reuse relationship as src/config.rs — cache_root() at src/cache.rs:87 is the recommended anchor for the new store's on-disk location.
